name: White Lightning - Aviation Ground Power
old_description: From our years of building high current DC power supplies for demonstrating mobile electronics and our continuous involvement in general aviation since 1980, comes our line of Ground Power Units to safely power cockpit and airframe systems with clean, stable airframe power. We also distribute the aviation-specific BatteryMINDer® and provide wiring kits for FAA-certified aircraft to simplify installation and increase safety.
about:
White Lightning Aviation Ground Power is based in Lexington, Kentucky. The company traces its roots to the 1980s when founder Jon Sisk, a longtime pilot, began building high-current DC power supplies for mobile electronics demonstrations. Recognizing a need for reliable, affordable ground power units in general aviation, Sisk and his engineering team developed the first Enhanced Flight GPU, establishing the company's focus on airframe ground power.

The company designs and manufactures a line of ground power units (GPUs) covering 14 V, 28 V, and dual‑voltage configurations, including smart GPUs with integrated battery‑maintenance chargers. It also produces aviation‑grade power cables, wiring harnesses, and plug assemblies, and distributes the BatteryMINDer® line of charger‑maintainers. All manufacturing is done in the United States, with product models such as the M2875‑114 (114 A, 28 V), M2827 (27 A, 24/28 V), M1428‑DV (dual‑voltage mini), M2850 (50 A, 28 V), and several 14 V variants for certified and experimental aircraft.

White Lightning serves the general‑aviation, business‑aviation, flight‑training, and aircraft‑maintenance markets. Its equipment is used to power cockpit avionics — such as Garmin G1000 suites — during preflight, maintenance, database updates, and training without draining the aircraft battery. Customers include owners of certified aircraft like the Cessna Skylane and Piper Navajo, as well as experimental/amateur‑build operators.

The company was started because Jon Sisk saw a gap in affordable, reliable hangar ground power. It differentiates itself by pursuing three principles: sensibly designed, well‑made products at reasonable prices; great customer service with direct phone support; and manufacturing everything possible in the USA.
